title: AI review finding filter
description: Decide for each AI review finding on a diff whether to post it, collapse it or drop it

diff.description: the diff the findings are about

real.instructions: Is the review finding a real bug that is INTRODUCED BY THE ADDED LINES of this diff (lines starting with +)? Pre-existing code and style nits do not count.

criteria.true: The added lines create a concrete defect that will misbehave at runtime
criteria.false: Style nit, speculation, already-handled case, or problem in unchanged code

combine: post if real >= post_at; collapse if real >= collapse_at; drop otherwise
limitations: long diffs are slow (the diff is re-sent with every finding; the prefix is cached)
sees only the diff in state
the decision is the most severe over the findings; read items for each finding
notes: # deviation: spec 5.7: one request per finding through read_per_item; the outcome decision is the most severe finding decision (post > collapse > drop) and items carry each finding's decision; a failed read gives collapse (spec: unsure), which neither posts nor drops
